title: Event-Based Dynamic Lip Region Estimation During Speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.23111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. These include automatic lip reading, audiovisual speech analysis, and human-robot interaction, particularly in challenging environments characterized by low illumination or high dynamic range. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection, however, mostly operate on a cropped region of interest (ROI), by hand or by the dataset, and no event-based method supplies that ROI as a spatial region; existing event-based face analysis gives the mouth as landmarks, which presents a mismatch between application and localization. The present work predicts a dense heatmap over the lip region from the full event "frame". Events are encoded as a polarity-separated voxel grid and processed at every location by a two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) with learned, log-space bounded

translated_title: 基于事件相机的语音过程中动态唇部区域估计
translated_abstract: 事件相机具有高时间分辨率和低功耗的特点，使其在语音相关应用中前景广阔，这些应用包括自动唇读、视听语音分析以及人机交互，尤其适用于低照度或高动态范围等具有挑战性的环境。然而，现有的基于事件的唇读、说话人识别和语音活动检测方法大多在手工定义或由数据集给定的裁剪感兴趣区域（ROI）上运行，目前尚无基于事件的方法能够以空间区域的形式提供该ROI；而现有基于事件的人脸分析仅以关键点的形式给出嘴部位置，这造成了应用与定位之间的不匹配。本工作从完整的事件“帧”中预测唇部区域的密集热力图。事件被编码为极性分离的体素网格，并由具有可学习的对数空间界限的双通路连续时间循环网络（CT-RNN）在每一个位置进行处理。
tldr: 本文提出首个从完整事件帧预测唇部区域密集热力图的方法，为事件相机的唇读等语音应用提供了自动的动态唇部空间定位，解决了现有方法依赖手工裁剪ROI或关键点定位与应用需求不匹配的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first event-based method that predicts a dense heatmap of the dynamic lip region from full event frames, providing automatic spatial ROI localization for event-based speech applications and resolving the mismatch between hand-cropped ROIs or landmark-based localization and application needs.
